book.minecraft_mode.guide.page1:
Welcome to Stormhold, the capital of adventurers!

The city around 0, 0 is a safe zone: monsters do not spawn, buildings cannot be broken and players cannot fight each other.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page10:
Every three days

Lair treasure is personal and refills every 3 Minecraft days, after you defeat the lair lord. Raid rewards (Normal, Heroic, Nightmare) reset on the same cycle.

Guild Clerk Lina hands out bounties for merit.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page11:
Growing stronger

Artisan Brokk at the forge enhances class gear up to +15. Broker Morgan runs the market at the stall with the lectern.

Talents: N. Codex, achievements and titles: J.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page12:
The main story

Royal Herald Elric waits on the plaza. Hear his chapters, reach each goal and come back for the reward (/story, codex J).

Past level 100 you gain paragon levels (N) and can awaken +15 gear.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page13:
Dungeons and events

Dungeon Warden Kael stands by the dungeon gate in the keep courtyard: 2-4 players, three halls and a boss. Keystones make them harder and timed.

At dusk titans rise in the wilds, and every third day the capital is invaded.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page14:
Pets, mounts and crafts

Pet charms and mount whistles join your collection (U); press H to ride your mount.

Cook, brew and smith at the stations in the market and the forge; herbs drop from grass and flowers.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page2:
City map (north)

Center: Plaza (spawn)
North: the Keep, raid gate
Northwest: Mage tower, Enchanter's Hall
Northeast: Warrior arena, Hunter Association
West: Old Town, Shadow Hall
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page3:
City map (south)

East: Cathedral, homes
Southwest: Archer park, Urahara Shop
South: Market, Alchemist, Guild, forge
Southeast: Harbor
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page4:
Classes

Reach level 10 by defeating monsters and mining iron or better ores, then talk to the trainer of the class you want: you take the class on the spot. Every class has its own trainer, trials, weapons and armor.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page5:
Trainers

Bedivere - Warrior
Hanzo - Rogue
Merlin - Mage
Chiron - Archer
Drake - Pirate
Urahara - Soul Reaper
Biscuit - Hunter
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page6:
Advancement trials

The first class needs no trial. From tier 2 on, every advancement is a trial: defeat the listed enemies, collect the trial tokens they drop, and bring them back with essence.

Tiers unlock at levels 10, 25, 45 and 70.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page7:
Weapons and skills

Class weapons are sold at the Guild in the south market. Use skills with R, X, V and Z; open the class screen with K. Skills only work for the weapon's class, tier and level.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page8:
Essence

Essence drops from monsters and iron or better ores. Engrave class gear at the engraving tables in the Guild: up to 3 lines on weapons and 4 on armor, and the same line stacks.
book.minecraft_mode.guide.page9:
Wallet and supplies

Coins go straight into your wallet and take no inventory space; shops are paid from it (/wallet). You keep your items when you die.

The Alchemist sells potions and food that last 10 minutes.

guide.minecraft_mode.bounties.text:
Guild Clerk Lina hands out three daily bounties and one three-day bounty; they pay merit for the merit shop.

Achievements give merit and titles; wear titles from the codex (J). Royal Herald Elric here on the plaza tells the main story.
guide.minecraft_mode.classes.text:
Seven classes: Warrior, Rogue, Mage, Archer, Pirate, Soul Reaper and Hunter. The first class is free: at level 10 the trainer makes you one on the spot. From tier 2 on, every advancement is a trial from the class trainer: defeat the listed monsters, collect their trial tokens and hand them in with essence. Tiers open at levels 10, 25, 45 and 70.

The class screen (K) shows your next trial and where its trainer stands. Past level 100 you gain paragon levels.
guide.minecraft_mode.companions.text:
Pet charms and mount whistles come from the merit shop, named monsters, lairs, dungeons, raids and the story. U opens your collection, H calls your mount.

Cook and brew at the stations in the market and smith at the forge; herbs drop from grass and flowers.
guide.minecraft_mode.dungeons.text:
Raids: Raid Marshal Aldric by the keep, parties of up to 6, six bosses on Normal, Heroic and Nightmare; rewards once every three days.

Dungeons: Dungeon Warden Kael in the keep courtyard, 2-4 players, five dungeons. Your first clear gives a keystone for harder, timed runs. You lose nothing when you fall in a raid or dungeon.

Hunting together (/party create, /party invite <name>): everyone with at least 5% of the contribution shares the class EXP by contribution, with a bonus for each extra hunter. Damage counts, and so do healing allies, buffing them and debuffing the monster. The top contributor rolls the gear and pet drops.
guide.minecraft_mode.events.text:
Every day at dusk a titan rises in the wilds (two days of three) or the capital is invaded (the third). Everyone who fights is rewarded.

Lair treasure, raid rewards and the three-day bounty renew every three Minecraft days.
guide.minecraft_mode.gear.text:
The Guild sells one class weapon and one armor piece per 10 levels; the rest drops. Engrave gear with essence at the engraving tables, evolve it with Master Smith Volund (Evolution Ether), and enhance it to +15 and awaken it to ✦5 with Artisan Brokk.

Weapon skills only work when your class, tier and level match the weapon. The Guild buys class gear you carry for 30% of its price (enhancement and engravings are not paid for).
guide.minecraft_mode.keys.text:
K class screen
N talents and paragon
J codex, achievements, titles, story
R / X / V / Z skills
B innate ability (level 20)
U pets and mounts
H call or dismiss your mount
Y raid loot
M world map, comma (,) minimap on/off

/wallet, /party, /raid leave, /dungeon leave, /story
guide.minecraft_mode.leveling.text:
Level 10 takes %s EXP. A monster gives EXP equal to its max health (zombie or skeleton 20, spider 16), so about %s zombies; ores are slow.

· Fastest: the Training Grounds under the city (stairs in the park south-east of the fountain). Monsters keep coming and give double EXP until you choose a class: about %s zombies
· Take Bram's unbreakable gear and shield and Hanna's bread
· Scholar's Coffee from the alchemist (3 silver): +15%% EXP for 10 min
· Dying costs 10%% of this level's EXP
guide.minecraft_mode.money.text:
9 copper = 1 silver, 9 silver = 1 gold. Monsters and named monsters drop coins.

The south market has the general store, blacksmith, grocer, jeweler and alchemist, the Adventurers' Guild (class gear) and Broker Morgan's market where players trade with each other. Prices rise for a while as an item is traded a lot.
guide.minecraft_mode.named.text: Named monsters ([Lv.N] name tags) appear now and then in their biomes and drop gear, Evolution Ether and coins. Each has a lair: defeat its lair lord and the treasure is yours again every three days. A lair map points to the nearest one.
guide.minecraft_mode.start.text:
Defeat monsters and mine ores (the rarer, the more) to gain class experience (see Leveling to 10). At level 10, talk to the trainer whose class you want and take it on the spot.

First pick up the unbreakable Quartermaster's gear and shield from Bram and today's bread from Baker Hanna here on the plaza. Coins go straight into your wallet (/wallet), and you keep your items when you die.

quest.minecraft_mode.archer_1.story: Pick up the bow and keep your eyes on the far horizon.
quest.minecraft_mode.archer_2.story: Rangers guard the night sky. Down phantoms and keep your aim true from afar.
quest.minecraft_mode.archer_3.story: A heroic archer can hit a ghast across a lava sea. Prove it, and fell a golem.
quest.minecraft_mode.archer_4.story: The King of Heroes keeps his treasury locked with keys of gold. Defeat the Wither to claim them.
quest.minecraft_mode.hunter_1.story: You passed the Hunter Exam. Here is your license - what you hunt is up to you.
quest.minecraft_mode.hunter_2.story: A glass of water and a leaf will tell what kind of Nen you have. Train hard enough to make it move.
quest.minecraft_mode.hunter_3.story: The Chimera Ants are spreading. Break their golem guard and wipe out the nests.
quest.minecraft_mode.hunter_4.story: Only a Triple-Star Hunter may join the expedition. Bring back a relic from the deep dark and its Warden.
quest.minecraft_mode.mage_1.story: You can already feel the faint mana every apprentice learns to sense. Speak your first spell.
quest.minecraft_mode.mage_2.story: Witches and illusioners stole pages of the great grimoire. Take them back.
quest.minecraft_mode.mage_3.story: The tower's hearth needs blaze embers and the heart of a mythril golem.
quest.minecraft_mode.mage_4.story: Beyond the End lies the Akashic Record. Slay the dragon that guards its door.
quest.minecraft_mode.pirate_1.story: Raise your own flag. The sea belongs to whoever dares to sail it.
quest.minecraft_mode.pirate_2.story: Every captain needs a bounty. Raid the guardians of the monuments and the pillagers' outposts.
quest.minecraft_mode.pirate_3.story: An Emperor's haki breaks beasts. Crush a golem and the hoglins of the Nether.
quest.minecraft_mode.pirate_4.story: The great treasure waits at the end of the sea. Defeat the Elder Guardian and the drowned who guard it.
quest.minecraft_mode.rogue_1.story: The Thieves' Guild opens its doors to you. Step into the shadows.
quest.minecraft_mode.rogue_2.story: A ninja strikes before the bowstring is drawn. Hunt skeletons and recover the stolen scrolls.
quest.minecraft_mode.rogue_3.story: Nothing is true, everything is permitted. Bring down a golem and the endermen who watch from the dark.
quest.minecraft_mode.rogue_4.story: Defeat the Warden of the deep dark. Its shadow will kneel before its new monarch.
quest.minecraft_mode.shinigami_1.story: Take up the zanpakuto and guide the lingering dead to rest before they turn into Hollows.
quest.minecraft_mode.shinigami_2.story: Your zanpakuto will only tell you its name in the dark between worlds. Hunt the endermen and follow the hell butterflies.
quest.minecraft_mode.shinigami_3.story: Bankai takes ten years - or three days with a Tenshintai. Break a golem and the frozen dead to earn one.
quest.minecraft_mode.shinigami_4.story: Beyond the white desert, a traitor waits with the Hogyoku. Destroy the Wither and the husks of the sands.
quest.minecraft_mode.warrior_1.story: Take up the sword and stand in the front line. Every Warrior starts here.
quest.minecraft_mode.warrior_2.story: The arena masters want illager blood. Win their laurels in real battle.
quest.minecraft_mode.warrior_3.story: Shatter a Mythril Golem and drink the frenzy of the Nether's skeleton knights.
quest.minecraft_mode.warrior_4.story: Only one who has felled the Wither may draw the sword of kings.

raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.aethryx_jud: Gather on the marked player: 60% of the party must share the blow.
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.aethryx_sea: Every seal needs someone standing on it when the stars fall.
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.arachne_ven: The floor floods with venom! Get inside a silk cocoon (green circle).
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.gorvath_roc: The peak comes down on everyone Gorvath can see. Hide behind a pillar!
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.gorvath_sho: A peak is falling: 60% of the party must stand in the green circle together.
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.ignis_phoen: Destroy every ember warden within 15 seconds or the eggs hatch in a supernova.
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.ignis_solar: Turn your back on Ignis before the flash!
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.kraken_anch: Someone must hold every anchor (green circles) or the ship goes down.
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.kraken_ink_: Every mark bursts and kills anyone else within 6 blocks. Spread out!
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.malachar_do: The marked must reach the soul font (green circle) within 10 seconds.
You bear the mark of Doom! Get to the soul font!
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.malachar_ph: Malachar cannot be hurt while his guardians stand. Destroy them all in 20 seconds!
raid.minecraft_mode.mechanic.malachar_st: When the requiem begins, do not move a step.

story.minecraft_mode.below_the_keep.rewa: a pet charm (coins if you own them all)
story.minecraft_mode.below_the_keep.text: Beneath the keep the dungeon warden keeps the gate to dark places. Gather companions and clear a dungeon.
story.minecraft_mode.call_to_arms.text: Darkness stirs beyond the walls, and Stormhold needs fighters. Find a class trainer in the city and take up a path.
story.minecraft_mode.craftsmanship.text: An army marches on food, potions and good steel. Learn a profession at the market or the forge and master its basics.
story.minecraft_mode.first_steps.text: Every hero starts small. Hunt beyond the walls and grow stronger; come back when you have some experience behind you.
story.minecraft_mode.hero_of_stormhold.t: Only one step remains: reach the pinnacle of your strength. The realm will remember your name.
story.minecraft_mode.lair_secrets.text: The named ones hoard treasure in their lairs. Find one, defeat its guardians and open the chest at its heart.
story.minecraft_mode.marshals_call.text: Six great monsters threaten the realm. The raid marshal is gathering parties. Answer his call and fell one of them.
story.minecraft_mode.named_threats.text: Some monsters have grown cunning and earned names. Scouts report them across the wilds. Prove you can bring them down.
story.minecraft_mode.second_path.text: Your trainer says you are ready for more. Complete their trial and advance your class.
story.minecraft_mode.titan_wakes.text: At dusk the land shakes: titans rise from the wilds. When one appears, join the others and bring it down.
story.minecraft_mode.trial_of_keys.text: Keystones lead to harder dungeons. Beat a +5 keystone within its time to show the warden what you are made of.
tooltip.minecraft_mode.companion.use: Use: add it to your collection (summon with P)
tooltip.minecraft_mode.condensed_essence: Use: break into 9 essence (sneak: whole stack)
tooltip.minecraft_mode.essence.change: Essence and condensed essence pay for each other (change comes back as essence)
tooltip.minecraft_mode.gear.locked: Requirements not met: cannot be worn
tooltip.minecraft_mode.keystone.use: Bring it to the dungeon warden; beat the timer to raise it.
tooltip.minecraft_mode.weapon.locked: Requirements not met: basic attacks only
tooltip.minecraft_mode.weapon.no_engravi: Engrave it at an Essence Engraving Table
